conflicts.permit: Sensitive permissions will be used exclusively for improving app's features and enhancing user's experience in utilizing the app and the functionality in general.
conflicts.prohibit: These third parties are prohibited from using your personal information for any other purpose without your specific consent.
conflicts.situation: Using sensitive permission data for other operational purposes
conflicts.reason: One clause restricts sensitive permissions exclusively to feature improvement and user experience, while another contemplates third-party usage for other purposes with consent or general operations without clear hierarchy.
